positions.name: CalibrationVerifiedAgainstReferencePlates
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration validated against a reference standard?
positions.why: All three expressions converge on the same directional read: a flat, technical-report register stating the instrument's identity, its calibration value, and the fact that this value was checked against the June reference plates and holds across the band. src-1 gives the narrative assertion, src-2 and src-3 restate the same content as labelled fields — same authority-ranking, expert, competence-valued verification move, just compressed into a spec sheet. No tension: all three agree the calibration is settled and reference-checked.
